title: Google Research publishes study on AI-assisted gestational age assessment
excerpt: A prospective study shows an AI model can estimate gestational age using blind sweep ultrasound scans with accuracy comparable to expert sonographers.
bodyHtml:
On October 21, 2026, Google Research published a study in JAMA Network Open evaluating an AI model designed to interpret blind sweep ultrasounds. This scanning method allows operators without specialized sonography training to perform assessments by moving a portable ultrasound probe across the abdomen in a standardized pattern.

The study tested the model prospectively in Chicago, Illinois, and Nairobi, Kenya. Across both cohorts, the AI model achieved a mean absolute error of 4.18 days in estimating gestational age, compared to 4.48 days for expert sonographers. In Nairobi, where the model received no local fine-tuning, it achieved a mean absolute error of 4.27 days.

The research team fine-tuned the model using a dataset of 120 participants from Chicago before the prospective testing phase. The final evaluation included 385 participants between 16 and 36 weeks of pregnancy.
topic: Empowering frontline maternal care with AI-assisted ultrasound
